title: Nvidia to backstop up to ~$105B for OpenAI's Ohio data-center campus
summary: Nvidia is reportedly guaranteeing up to $105 billion of financing for a 20-year OpenAI data-centre lease in Pike County, Ohio, scaled back from an earlier $250B guarantee after investor pushback.
reason: Exclusive mega compute-financing tie between dominant chip vendor and leading lab.

title: Anthropic run-rate hits $65B; Q2 revenue overtakes OpenAI
summary: Anthropic told investors its annualised revenue reached $65B in July; WSJ reported its Q2 sales of $11.6B more than doubled, versus OpenAI's $6.7B.
reason: Revenue concentration among two frontier labs; financial news, T1.

title: Trump-linked crypto firm backs venture selling AI to US-restricted Chinese firms
summary: Reuters reported World Liberty Financial backs WorldClaw, a venture offering AI services to Chinese companies targeted by US restrictions.

title: Sainsbury's pauses Facewatch at store after false shoplifting flag
summary: A Sainsbury's facial-recognition camera wrongly flagged a paying customer as a shoplifter, and the store suspended Facewatch scanning at that branch.
reason: Company drops a surveillance deployment locally (F6 T1 down).

title: AI-assisted search lowers matrix-multiplication exponent to 2.371177
summary: Researchers used AI tools including AlphaEvolve to improve the bound on the matrix multiplication exponent from 2.371339 to 2.371177.
reason: Small but real AI-aided math result; incremental.
